title: Private VPC quickstart (alpha): publish Terraform modules flow + installer preflight troubleshooting
author: Elliot Price
description: ## Summary This PR updates the docs site content for the **Redwood Private VPC Quickstart (Alpha)**. The goal is to give Solutions Engineering and design partners a single, repeatable path from "blank AWS account" to "ready for redwood-private-installer" using the new `redwood-terraform` VPC modules, while being explicit about what is **alpha** vs **GA** expectations. This also incorporates common pilot failure modes (missing ECR endpoints / private DNS, intermittent DNS resolution, and flow log destination confusion) and aligns wording with Security guidance on logging + IAM boundaries. ## Audience Primarily internal + design partners during alpha ("public-ish" docs site section). The page is written assuming: (1) customer has AWS account + admin or equivalent, (2) we are deploying to AWS VPC (EKS assumed), (3) they are comfortable with Terraform and VPC endpoints, (4) installer does the cluster/app install; these docs cover networking + foundational infra. ## Key changes - New Quickstart landing page: scope statement + alpha support expectations + prerequisites checklist. - Step-by-step guide: Terraform modules -> validate -> handoff outputs to installer -> run installer preflight. - Troubleshooting section expanded with concrete checks for endpoints + DNS (ties to installer preflight warnings from ENG-4869 and recent support tickets SUP-28411/SUP-28458). - Security posture section: default logging destinations and IAM boundary expectations; explicitly calls out what defaults are recommended vs required. - "What’s alpha" callout boxes and "Supported topologies" table moved near the top (to reduce discovery churn). ## Content decisions (intentional) - We do **not** claim GA-level SLA/support for the Terraform modules (alpha). - We do **not** document deep enterprise topology variants (DX/VPN specifics) beyond a placeholder section and links to extension points; SE/PS engagement required. - We do **not** include customer-identifying example tfvars; we include a sanitized minimal example with commentary. ## Screenshots/Examples (snippets) Terraform minimal module usage (docs): ```hcl module "redwood_private_vpc" { source = "github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-terraform//modules/aws-private-vpc?ref=v0.1.0-alpha.4" name_prefix = var.name_prefix region = var.region vpc_cidr = "10.40.0.0/16" enable_vpc_endpoints = true flow_logs_destination = "cloudwatch" } ``` Installer preflight expectation (docs): - Required endpoints (minimum): ECR (api + dkr), S3 (gateway), STS, CloudWatch Logs (if using CW flow logs), EC2 (for some bootstrap flows). - Private DNS must be enabled for ECR interface endpoints in most customer setups, otherwise image pulls fail (see SUP-28411). ## Checklist - [x] Aligns with alpha positioning in PM-928 - [x] Links to Terraform module repo + version pin guidance - [x] Calls out known limitations (single-region, assumptions around EKS private control plane) - [x] Adds troubleshooting for endpoints/DNS/NAT - [x] Security review requested for logging/IAM wording
commits: docs(private): add alpha quickstart landing page and navigation entry
docs(private): write Terraform -> installer handoff guide (outputs + variables)
docs(troubleshooting): add endpoint/DNS checks + link to installer preflight messages
docs(security): clarify flow logs defaults, retention guidance, and customer-owned destinations
chore(ci): fix broken link check config for new private docs paths
review_conversation: Kira Thompson (review): The flow is solid, but we need to be extremely clear that this is alpha and not the fully supported path for all enterprise customers. Can we add a callout at the top about support boundaries and that PS/SE involvement is expected for non-standard networking (DX/VPN/proxy egress)?

Elliot Price (author): Added an "Alpha scope" section on the landing page with (a) supported topologies, (b) what we validate, (c) what requires PS/SE. Also added an explicit line: "If you have mandatory proxy egress or custom DNS appliances, expect an engagement."

Naomi Feldman (review): The "Security and logging" page currently reads like CW flow logs are required. For alpha we should say recommended defaults; requirement depends on customer policy. Also please avoid implying Redwood collects customer VPC logs by default.

Elliot Price (author): Updated wording: flow logs are "recommended" with defaults; destination is customer-owned (CW log group in customer account or S3 bucket in customer account). Added a note that Redwood does not receive VPC flow logs unless customer configures export to their SIEM and shares it separately.

Markus Klein (review): Troubleshooting is missing the most common pilot issue: ECR pulls failing when private DNS is off for interface endpoints. Please make that a first-class troubleshooting item with exact symptoms and where to look.

Elliot Price (author): Added "Symptom: ImagePullBackOff / cannot resolve api.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com" section, included checks: endpoint exists, private_dns_enabled, VPC resolver, route tables, and pointed to installer preflight warnings. Linked SUP-28411 for internal context.
Simran Kaur (review): The supported topologies table is helpful, but can we move it up? People won't read it if it's at the end. Also ensure we don't promise on-prem parity here.
Elliot Price (author): Moved Supported topologies directly under prerequisites on the landing page and added "AWS-only in alpha" note with a link to roadmap (internal).
Sahana Iyer (review): CI failing on link-check due to new anchors and the GitHub ref pin link. Please fix allowlist or use relative links.
Elliot Price (author): Fixed by switching to relative links for internal pages and added the terraform module repo link pattern to allowlist. Re-ran CI.

Naomi Feldman (follow-up): One more nit: the IAM section references "installer execution role" permissions. Please clarify that customers can bring their own role but the module scaffolds a least-privilege baseline with optional permission boundary hooks.
Elliot Price (author): Updated IAM wording accordingly, and added a short "bring your own role" paragraph with the expected minimum capabilities (no explicit policy JSON in docs).
Kira Thompson (approval): Approved with the alpha callouts and support boundaries added. Please ensure the landing page title includes "Alpha" to avoid confusion.
Elliot Price (author): Updated H1 + nav label to "Private VPC Quickstart (Alpha)".
Markus Klein (approval): Looks good for design partner kickoff materials. Thanks for making the endpoint/DNS section explicit.
release_notes: Docs: Added Private VPC Quickstart (Alpha) covering Terraform VPC modules flow and installer handoff
Docs: Added troubleshooting for ECR endpoints/private DNS and intermittent DNS resolution
Docs: Clarified alpha support boundaries and security/logging defaults
